The notice board is read by facing it and pressing E. But it's on my own tile. Let me reconsider: maybe the notice board is actually at a tile adjacent and the observe is reporting my tile. Let me look at the raw map again — the 'o' in the earlier map at (7,6) was the gold door. The notice board wasn't shown as 'o' anywhere in the map view. 

Wait — in the first map, row 7 was `#.@P....#...#` — so (2,7)='@', (3,7)='P'. No 'o' at (2,7). So the notice board is NOT drawn on the map as blocking. But observe says "Notice Board (notice) at (2,7): blocks". 

Maybe the notice board is at (2,7) but the map legend doesn't render notices. And I'm standing on it. The game may have placed me on the notice tile at spawn, and now I'm stuck because the tile is blocked.

Let me try pressing E while facing up repeatedly, or try interacting with the notice board by facing it. Since it's my tile, maybe I need to face a specific direction. Let me try all directions with E and check for a "read" event.
